back: A correct network must reach ~0 loss on 8 examples; if not, there is a bug.
Learning rate too large (or log of 0); lower it 10x first.
Try $10^{-3},10^{-2},10^{-1},1$ for a few hundred steps; take the largest that does not diverge.
Batch size changes noise and the best learning rate; retune when it changes.
Shuffle $X$ and $y$ with the same permutation.
Check label/feature alignment and class imbalance.
Overfitting, not a bug: regularise or get more data.
